thread:
anya: quick checkpoint — need green across licensing + perf for harborX and navis7b to hit catalog launch next wed. who has final signoff?
legal-bot: harborX license: CC-BY-4.0 compatible, third-party tokenizer patent flagged for review (ticket #ML-4821). navis7b: pending contributor CLA.
jason: I own harborX — will take the patent note. pinging @legal for the patent review slot. I pushed perf numbers yesterday but will re-run after quantization.
miko: uploaded perf profile for harborX -> gs://redwood-model-bench/harborX/profiles/v1.json. 8k tokens median latency 210ms on p4d, 1.2x baseline.
sam: for quantized path we need the qkv reorder patch merged (PR #2567). infra needs to cut a dedicated pool config otherwise dedicated can't host the q8 runtime.
sophia: infra change is in review, slight risk — target merge EOD today. if it slips, dedicated rollout shifts a day.
anya: ok. action items: (1) @jason handle patent followup with legal, (2) @miko confirm perf after q8 build, (3) @sam follow infra PR status, (4) devex add a quick launch checklist entry for tokenizer shape verification.
jason: started patent thread with @legal, put initial notes in ML-4821. ETA tomorrow noon. :white_check_mark:
miko: re-ran profile with q8 build on staging -> median 180ms, 95p 420ms. pushed to same GCS path with suffix -q8. note: tokenization changed output ids for ~0.3% of testset.
devex: will add tokenizer shape + sample prompts test to the checklist. also adding an explicit e2e smoke that runs generation -> postprocess -> compare emb similarity.
sam: infra PR merged, pool configs staged. scheduling dedicated pool create at 02:00 UTC tomorrow.
anya: excellent. two quick asks: can someone open the model-metadata PR for catalog entries? and who'll own the canary traffic ramp?
jason: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/389 — needs one LGTM and a small metadata lint fix.
sophia: I'll own canary ramp and monitoring. plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 3 hours, rollback on error rate > 0.5% or latency > 2x baseline.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled for harborX on 2026-03-19T02:30:00Z per @sophia plan.
anya: perfect. last thing — any blocking CRs or eval regressions?
miko: small eval drift on long-form summarization (ROUGE -0.8) after q8; investigating prompt tuning to recover.
jason: metadata lint fixed, PR ready for review. tagging @miko @sophia for final checks.
legal-bot: reminder: contributor CLA for navis7b must be cleared before public catalog entry. created ticket ML-4829.
anya: thanks team. I'll consolidate action items in the product board and post a short prelaunch note in #product later. ping here if anything slips. :thumbsup:
